usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named view from the Proxmox Datacenter Manager configuration. Requires the Resource.Modify privilege on the 'view' path. Pass the optional digest parameter (obtained from the read/list endpoint) to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Delete a view named 'prod-cluster' using a digest for safe concurrent modification protection

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named view and all of its configuration from PDM; there is no undo and the view must be recreated manually if deleted in error.
tips: Fetch the current digest via the corresponding GET/list endpoint and pass it to prevent race conditions when multiple operators may be modifying views simultaneously.
The id must be 2–32 characters, starting with an alphanumeric or underscore, followed by alphanumeric, dot, underscore, or hyphen characters.
Returns null on success — no confirmation payload is included; treat an HTTP 200 with null body as the success signal.
